Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this one-sided game where Afghanistan takes an early lead in the series and UAE will need to go back to the drawing board and come back stronger in the next one to level things up. The 2nd T20I will be played on 31st December, Sunday at 7.30 pm IST (2 pm GMT), but as you know, you can always join us early for all the build-up to the match. Until then, cheers and goodbye!

Afghanistan's captain, Ibrahim Zadran says that it is his first time captaining the country and it is a surreal experience. Adds that they have a pretty decent T20I side and in the absence of Rashid Khan, Qais Ahmad bowled brilliantly. Tells that they try to play positive cricket and will continue to do so. Praises Rahmanullah Gurbaz for his century and says his role in the team is to anchor but he got out unfortunately.

Rahmanullah Gurbaz is the Player of the Match for his stellar ton. He starts by thanking the Almighty. Adds that he enjoyed batting today and it was really exciting to play the innings. States that his plan was to give the strike to Hazratullah Zazai as he was doing well. Mentions that it was not pre-planned to hit this big but everything went in the right direction. He also thanks the crowd as the support in UAE is always massive for Afghanistan.

Muhammad Waseem, the skipper of UAE says that he would like to congratulate Rahmanullah Gurbaz for such a special innings and he says that it was a good wicket but the runs were a little too much for us to achieve. He added that the guys are young and still fresh to this stage but they are all very talented and will definitely look to bounce back in the future games. He ends by saying that they were not able to execute their plans as they would have liked and Afghanistan played really well bringing in the experience that they carry but UAE will bounce back in the upcoming games.
Time for the presentation ceremony....

Earlier in the game, Afghanistan posted a huge total on the board courtesy of a stunning hundred from Rahmanullah Gurbaz and a brilliant fifty from the skipper Ibrahim Zadran. For UAE, Aayan Khan stood out with one wicket and was economical as well while the others were taken to the cleaners. Only if their catching was up to point, things could have been different. Muhammad Jawadullah and Junaid Siddique got the other two wickets. While chasing, their batters failed to get going except for Vriitya Aravind who did put up a good fight but that was never going to be enough for the UAE.

Afghanistan, on the other hand, were excellent with the ball. Both Naveen-ul-Haq and Fazalhaq Farooqi used the conditions well and moved the ball viciously which also helped them to strike three early blows. The spinners were  brilliant as well in the middle overs to keep the batters quiet and put even more pressure on the hosts. Qais Ahmad ended up with a wicket as well but it really an overall effort which helped them defend this total with ease.

UAE did not get the start they wanted as both their openers went back to the hut quite early with the big one being their captain Muhammad Waseem who could have been the key in this chase. The debutant, Samal Udawaththa also couldn't do much. Vriitya Aravind and Basil Hameed struggled initially but slowly steadied things for them. However, as the asking rate was always going up, Basil lost his wicket trying to change gears. Vritya was the line warrior for them with a fighting half-century while the other debutant, Tanish Suri looked unfazed by the situation and will be on to watch out for in the future. In the end, it proved to be too much for them as they fell short by 72 runs.

AFGHANISTAN GO 1-0 UP! A dominant victory for them as all the departments clicked for them and contributed equally. However, the highlight will obviously be that exceptional century from Rahmanullah Gurbaz that set up this game and their bowlers made sure to give absolutely nothing away. The Afghans will take a lot of confidence in the next game and try to wrap up the series with another win.
That is the end of the game and Afghanistan has won the game. Pitches the ball up on the off stump and Tanish Suri punches the ball through covers for a run.

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten! What a way to start the over! This one was back of length, on off, nipping it away. Vriitya Aravind stays back and gets uncomfortable to block the ball. Misses the delivery to his outer edge, the ball files over the wicket.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.1: Azmatullah Omarzai to Vriitya Aravind, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Azmatullah Omarzai comes into the attack.
Fazalhaq Farooqi bangs in a quick bouncer now, on middle, Basil Hameed dycks under it.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.6: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Basil Hameed, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good comeback from Fazalhaq Farooqi! He bowls this on a good length and on off, nips back in sharply, keeps low too, Basil Hameed tries to keep it out but misses due to the lack of bounce.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.5: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Basil Hameed, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Basil Hameed gets off the mark in style! Fazalhaq Farooqi serves thia  bit fuller and outside off, Basil Hameed frees his arms and smacks it over point for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.4: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Basil Hameed, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Basil Hameed walks into the middle to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Fazalhaq Farooqi strikes again! The short ball ploy has worked for Afghanistan. This is banged into he pitch hard, on middle and leg, Samal Udawaththa once again gets hurried into his pull shot and takes his eyes off as well. As a result, he mistimes it in the air and towards deep square leg where Qais Ahmad runs forward and pouches it safely. The debutant goes and United Arab Emirates are three down now!
Commentary.Howout: c Qais Ahmad b Fazalhaq Farooqi
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.3: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Samal Udawaththa, OUT! c Qais Ahmad b Fazalhaq Farooqi.

Commentary.Commentary: Fine stop! This is short of a length and outside off, Vriitya Aravind cuts hard again but the fielder at point dives to his left to make a brilliant stop. They cross.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.2: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Vriitya Aravind, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and around off, Vriitya Aravind cuts it wide of deep point for a brace.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Vriitya Aravind, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Halt! Samal Udawaththa gets a hit on the left shoulder and has asked for a little treatment. Looks good to continue now.

Naveen-ul-Haq ends the over with another sharp bumper, on middle, Samal Udawaththa gets hurried into his pull shot again and misses as the ball goes off his helmet over the keeper's head. Two leg byes taken. A mandatory concussion check will happen now.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.6: Naveen-ul-Haq to Samal Udawaththa, 2 Leg byes.

Commentary.Commentary: Naveen-ul-Haq bangs this short and on middle, Samal Udawaththa gets hurried and mistimes his pull over short fine leg for a couple of more runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Naveen-ul-Haq to Samal Udawaththa, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Pitched up and around off, Samal Udawaththa goes for the lofted drive but mistimes it a bit as the ball goes over extra covers. Two runs taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Naveen-ul-Haq to Samal Udawaththa, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and outside off, Vriitya Aravind cuts it through backward point for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Naveen-ul-Haq to Vriitya Aravind, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: JAFFA! Naveen-ul-Haq goes a bit fuller and on off, angles in and then straightens with extra bounce, Vriitya Aravind gets squared up as he tries to keep it out but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Naveen-ul-Haq to Vriitya Aravind, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Unplayble! Naveen-ul-Haq lands this on a hard length and on the sixth stump line, takes off viciously from the surface, Vriitya Aravind gets beaten all ends up as the keeper takes it over his head.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Naveen-ul-Haq to Vriitya Aravind, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length and outside off, Samal Udawaththa slashes at it but misses again.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Samal Udawaththa, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: This is on a hard length and in the channel outside off, nips back in, Samal Udawaththa looks to play at it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Samal Udawaththa, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Excellent keeping! Fazalhaq Farooqi lose his line and bowls this full but way down the leg side, Samal Udawaththa misses his glance and Rahmanullah Gurbaz behind the stumps dives to his right to make a brilliant stop. He certainly saved a boundary there. Wided.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Samal Udawaththa, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: BEATEN AGAIN! This is back of a length and outside off, shaping away again, Samal Udawaththa tries to cut it away from his body but misses again.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Samal Udawaththa, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: BEATEN! Fazalhaq Farooqi pulls his length back this time, on off, shaping away, Samal Udawaththa tries to push it away without much footwork and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Samal Udawaththa, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: EDGED BUT DROPPED! A tough chance though! Fazalhaq Farooqi serves this full and outside off, angling away, Vriitya Aravind goes for the flashing drive but gets an outside edge wide of first slip where Mohammad Nabi dives to his right, gets both hands but just fails to hold on to it. A single is taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Vriitya Aravind, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: BEAUTY! Fazalhaq Farooqi lands this on a good length and just around off, shaping away, Vriitya Aravind has a poke at it but misses as the ball just goes past the outside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Vriitya Aravind, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length and outside off, Samal Udawaththa bunts it down to point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Naveen-ul-Haq to Samal Udawaththa, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: This is pitched up and around off, shaping away, Samal Udawaththa looks to drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Naveen-ul-Haq to Samal Udawaththa, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FIVE WIDES! Free runs! Naveen-ul-Haq goes a touch fuller around leg, swings a long way to the leg side, Samal Udawaththa misses his flick and the keeper also fails to stop it as the ball runs to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Naveen-ul-Haq to Samal Udawaththa, 5 Wides!

Commentary.Commentary: Samal Udawaththa walks in to bat at number 4 for the United Arab Emirates.

OUT! TAKEN! Naveen-ul-Haq strikes now! A huge wicket for Afghanistan as they see the back of Muhammad Waseem. This is on a hard length and around middle, shaping in, Muhammad Waseem stays back tries to loft it over mid on but gets cramped and fails to get the elevation as Hazratullah Zazai there leaps up nicely and grabs a fine catch. Waseem stands there in disappointed but he will have to make that long walk back now. United Arab Emirates lose both their openers!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Naveen-ul-Haq to Muhammad Waseem, OUT! c Hazratullah Zazai b Naveen-ul-Haq.

Commentary.Commentary: In the air...safe! Naveen-ul-Haq lands this on a good length and on leg, slower too, Muhammad Waseem looks to flick but gets a leading edge which falls safely in the vacant mid-wicket region as the batters gets across for the second. Good running!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Naveen-ul-Haq to Muhammad Waseem, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and around off, Vriitya Aravind guides it towards third man for a run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Naveen-ul-Haq to Vriitya Aravind, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Naveen-ul-Haq begins with a full delivery as well, on middle, angling in, Muhammad Waseem flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Naveen-ul-Haq to Muhammad Waseem, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Naveen-ul-Haq to bowl the second over of the innings.
Touch fuller and on middle, shaping in as well, Vriitya Aravind looks to work it away but misses and gets hit on the pads. A slight appeal for LBW, but turned down.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Vriitya Aravind, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Vriitya Aravind is the new man in at number 3.

OUT! BOWLED'EM! Fazalhaq Farooqi draws first blood! He sets up the batter perfectly here. This is on a hard length and just around off, nips back in sharply again this time, Khalid Shah is second-guessing and tries to push it away without any footwork, and misses as the ball goes through the big gap between bat and pad to shatter the stumps. United Arab Emirates lose an early wicket!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Khalid Shah, OUT! b Fazalhaq Farooqi.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and outside off, Khalid Shah slashes hard at it but fails to connect.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Khalid Shah, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: BEAUTY! Fazalhaq Farooqi lands this on a hard length and on off, jags back in sharply, Khalid Shah gets cut in half as he looks to play but misses it completely.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Khalid Shah, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: First runs of the bat! This is on a good length and around leg, Muhammad Waseem nudges it through square leg for a single and gets off the mark.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Muhammad Waseem, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Goes fuller again and on middle, swinging in, Muhammad Waseem tucks it straight to short mid-wicket.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Muhammad Waseem, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: United Arab Emirates are underway with extras! Fazalhaq Farooqi starts with a full delivery but down the leg side, shaping in, Muhammad Waseem misses his flick. Wided.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Fazalhaq Farooqi to Muhammad Waseem, Wide!
